title: Alpha One — event checkout.session.expired v1
description: V1 catalog event `checkout.session.expired` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = ANA-01 (funnel/abandonment read model). Derived from: docs/12 §3.2 (TTL expiry: card 15 min / crypto 24 h; CHK-43 scheduled worker) + docs/32 `checkout_sessions` (id, price_snapshot{package_id}, reservation_expires_at); Decision 7 (2026-09-16). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.
